title: Been playing around a bit
author: Swarlz-Barkley
selftext:
So had an idea for a game. Has a campaign mode, but also an online multiplayer as well, which is all up and running currently. 

[https://play.docksidegame.com/](https://play.docksidegame.com/)

You can play as a guest, play against bots in the server if no ones on (which I imagine will be the case until people find the game and play) or sign up to have an account (which links to the forums)

As of now, the game does have an AntiCheat (but no actual cheats are out, since no one has played it. It's also not an auto ban, it will report which then mods can review and make a judgement later) and I have 2 US servers and 1 EU server. if it get's popular enough, I'll add more servers. 

This has been more of a learning project for me, get me back into coding again and learn how to do other things (like multiplayer, 3D modeling, ect. I don't have experience there so using AI to help me learn things has been a huge help)

Check it out, let me know what you think! There are some bugs and glitches but I do need actual play testers to help report them so I can fix since I know I will miss things

The next version is being worked on which includes MP ranks, skins, spin wheel, ect

Just to note, the game is not commercial. I do not accept money for anything in the game. It is completely and 100% Free to Play. There is an in game currency but the only way to earn is by playing matches against other players. It cannot be purchased.

The game was made with Claude and ChatGPT for the coding and in game models
